title: A Value of Information Framework for Climate Adaptation and Risk Management
abstract: The demand for information required to manage weather-related risks under changing climate conditions is growing. In response there have been efforts within both the public and private sectors to provide information from climate science to support adaptation decisions. Such information provision is complicated by the wide range of potential adaptation use-cases, the variable spatial and temporal scales of information required, and the lack of a systematic understanding of how scientific uncertainties propagate through adaptation decisions to affect the value to users. Here we propose value of information (VOI) as a useful conceptual framework for analyzing information designed to support adaptive decision-making. We describe the VOI framework and its usefulness for the adaptation context. We illustrate using a stylized set of decisions and a set of climate information states based on a modified Lorenz model.
abstract_zh: 在气候条件变化的背景下，管理与天气相关风险所需的信息需求正在不断增长。为此，公共部门和私营部门都在努力提供气候科学信息，以支持适应性决策。然而，此类信息的提供十分复杂：适应性应用场景种类繁多，所需信息的空间与时间尺度各不相同，而且人们缺乏对科学不确定性如何通过适应性决策传导并影响使用者价值的系统性认识。在此，我们提出以信息价值（VOI）作为分析支持适应性决策信息的有用概念框架。我们阐述了该信息价值框架及其在适应情境中的实用性。我们使用一组程式化的决策以及基于修正洛伦兹模型的一组气候信息状态进行了说明。

title: A Partial Rescue: Plant Range Shifts Sustain Local Diversity Without Alleviating Global Extinction
Spatial Selection Undermines Flood Protection in U.S. Wetland Markets
Synthesis of Evidence Yields High Social Cost of Carbon Due to Structural Model Variation and Uncertainties
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Estimating the cost to society from a ton of CO2—termed the social cost of carbon (SCC)—requires connecting a model of the climate system with a representation of the economic and social effects of changes in climate, and the aggregation of diverse, uncertain impacts across both time and space. A growing literature has examined the effect of fundamental structural elements of the models supporting SCC calculations. This work has accumulated in a piecemeal fashion, leaving their relative importance unclear. Here, we perform a comprehensive synthesis of the evidence on the SCC, combining 1,823 estimates of the SCC from 147 studies with a survey of authors of these studies. The distribution of published 2020 SCC values is wide and substantially right-skewed, showing evidence of a heavy right tail (truncated mean of $132). ANOVA reveals important roles for the inclusion of persistent damages, the representation of the Earth system, and distributional weighting. However, our survey reveals that experts believe the literature underestimates the SCC due to an undersampling of model structures, incomplete characterization of damages, and high discount rates. To address this imbalance, we train a random forest model on variation in the literature and use it to generate a synthetic SCC distribution that more closely matches expert assessments of appropriate model structure and discounting. This synthetic distribution has a mean of $283 per ton CO2 for a 2020 pulse year (5% to 95% range: $32 to $874), higher than most official government estimates, including a 2023 update from the U.S. EPA.
abstract_zh: 估算一吨二氧化碳给社会带来的成本，即碳的社会成本（SCC），需要将气候系统模型与气候变化的经济和社会效应表征连接起来，并在时间和空间上汇总多样且不确定的影响。已有大量文献考察了支撑SCC计算的模型中基本结构要素的作用，但这些研究较为零散地积累，使得各要素的相对重要性仍不明确。在此，我们对SCC的证据进行了全面综合，汇集了来自147项研究的1,823个SCC估计值，并结合了对这些研究作者的问卷调查。已发表的2020年SCC值分布较为分散，且明显右偏，呈现出较重的右尾（截尾均值为132美元）。方差分析显示，持续性损害的纳入、地球系统的刻画以及分配权重设定均具有重要作用。然而，我们的调查表明，专家认为由于模型结构取样不足、损害刻画不完整以及贴现率过高，文献低估了SCC。为纠正这种失衡，我们在文献中的变异上训练了一个随机森林模型，并利用它生成一个合成SCC分布，该分布更接近专家对适当模型结构和贴现的评估。该合成分布在2020年脉冲年份下的均值为每吨二氧化碳283美元（5%至95%分位区间：32美元至874美元），高于大多数官方政府估计，包括美国环保署（EPA）2023年的更新值。

title: The Increasing Benefits from Scarce Ecosystems
The Unaccounted-For Climate Costs of Materials
abstract: Materials production is a primary driver of anthropogenic greenhouse gas emissions; yet the externalized costs of these emissions on society are not reflected in market prices. Here, we estimate the externalized climate costs from materials production in the United States at approximately 79 billion USD per annum, and we highlight disparities in materials pricing. Proper accounting for such disparities can be leveraged to drive breakthroughs in technologies used for our material resources and manufacturing.
abstract_zh: 材料生产是人为温室气体排放的主要驱动因素，然而这些排放对社会造成的外部化成本并未反映在市场价格中。在此，我们估算出美国材料生产产生的外部化气候成本约为每年790亿美元，并强调了材料定价中存在的不平等。对此类不平等进行恰当的核算，可用于推动我们的材料资源和制造业所用技术取得突破。

title: Unequal Climate Impacts on Global Values of Natural Capital
abstract: Ecosystems generate a wide range of benefits for humans, including some market goods as well as other benefits that are not directly reflected in market activity1. Climate change will alter the distribution of ecosystems around the world and change the flow of these benefits2,3. However, the specific implications of ecosystem changes for human welfare remain unclear, as they depend on the nature of these changes, the value of the affected benefits and the extent to which communities rely on natural systems for their well-being4. Here we estimate country-level changes in economic production and the value of non-market ecosystem benefits resulting from climate-change-induced shifts in terrestrial vegetation cover, as projected by dynamic global vegetation models (DGVMs) driven by general circulation climate models. Our results show that the annual population-weighted mean global flow of non-market ecosystem benefits valued in the wealth accounts of the World Bank will be reduced by 9.2% in 2100 under the Shared Socioeconomic Pathway SSP2-6.0 with respect to the baseline no climate change scenario and that the global population-weighted average change in gross domestic product (GDP) by 2100 is −1.3% of the baseline GDP. Because lower-income countries are more reliant on natural capital, these GDP effects are regressive. Approximately 90% of these damages are borne by the poorest 50% of countries and regions, whereas the wealthiest 10% experience only 2% of these losses.
abstract_zh: 生态系统为人类带来多种效益，既包括部分市场商品，也包括无法直接反映在市场活动中的其他效益[1]。气候变化将改变全球生态系统的分布，并改变这些效益的流动[2,3]。然而，生态系统变化对人类福利的具体影响仍不清楚，因为这取决于变化的性质、受影响效益的价值，以及社区在多大程度上依赖自然系统维持福祉[4]。在此，我们估算了由气候变化引起的陆地植被覆盖变化（依据由通用环流气候模式驱动的动态全球植被模型（DGVM）所作预测）所导致的各国经济产出变化以及非市场生态系统效益价值的变化。结果表明，在共享社会经济路径SSP2-6.0情景下，相对于无气候变化的基准情景，世界银行财富账户中核算的非市场生态系统效益的年度人口加权全球平均流量，到2100年将减少9.2%；而按人口加权的全球平均国内生产总值（GDP）变化到2100年为基准GDP的−1.3%。由于低收入国家更依赖自然资本，这些GDP效应具有累退性。约90%的损失由最贫穷的50%的国家和地区承担，而最富裕的10%仅承担2%的损失。

title: New Potential to Reduce Uncertainty in Regional Climate Projections by Combining Physical and Socio-Economic Constraints
Biodiversity Mediates Ecosystem Sensitivity to Climate Variability
abstract: A rich body of evidence from local-scale experiments and observational studies has revealed stabilizing effects of biodiversity on ecosystem functioning. However, whether these effects emerge across entire regions and continents remains largely overlooked. Here we combine data on the distribution of more than 57,500 plant species and remote-sensing observations throughout the entire Western Hemisphere to investigate the role of multiple facets of plant diversity (species richness, phylogenetic diversity, and functional diversity) in mediating the sensitivity of ecosystems to climate variability at the regional-scale over the past 20 years. We show that, across multiple biomes, regions of greater plant diversity exhibit lower sensitivity (more stable over time) to temperature variability at the interannual and seasonal-scales. While these areas can display lower sensitivity to interannual variability in precipitation, they emerge as highly sensitive to precipitation seasonality. Conserving landscapes of greater diversity may help stabilize ecosystem functioning under climate change, possibly securing the continuous provisions of productivity-related ecosystem service to people.
abstract_zh: 大量来自局地尺度实验和观测研究的证据揭示了生物多样性对生态系统功能具有稳定作用。然而，这些效应是否会在整个区域乃至大陆尺度上显现，在很大程度上仍被忽视。在此，我们结合了超过57,500种植物物种的分布数据与整个西半球的遥感观测，以研究植物多样性的多个维度（物种丰富度、系统发育多样性和功能多样性）在过去20年中，对区域尺度上生态系统对气候变率敏感性的调节作用。我们发现，在多个生物群区中，植物多样性较高的区域对年际和季节尺度的温度变率表现出较低的敏感性（随时间更加稳定）。尽管这些地区对降水年际变率的敏感性可能较低，但它们对降水季节性却表现出高度敏感。保护多样性较高的景观，可能有助于在气候变化下稳定生态系统功能，并有可能确保与生产力相关的生态系统服务持续供给人类。

title: Climate Impacts on Natural Capital: Consequences for the Social Cost of Carbon
abstract: The effects of climate change on natural systems will be substantial, widespread, and likely irreversible. Warmer temperatures and changing precipitation patterns have already contributed to forest dieback and pushed some species toward extinction. Natural systems contribute to human welfare both as an input to the production of consumption goods and through the provision of nonuse values (i.e., existence and bequest values). But because they are often unpriced, it can be difficult to constrain these benefits. Understanding how climate change effects on the natural capital stock affect human well-being, and therefore the social cost of carbon (SCC), requires understanding not just the biophysical effects of climate change but also the particular role they play in supporting human welfare. This article reviews a range of topics from natural capital accounting through climate change economics important for quantifying the ecological costs of climate change and integrating these costs into SCC calculations.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对自然系统的影响将是重大、广泛且很可能是不可逆转的。气温升高和降水格局变化已经导致森林枯死，并使一些物种走向灭绝。自然系统既作为消费品生产的投入而促进人类福利，也通过提供非使用价值（即存在价值和遗赠价值）而促进人类福利。但由于这些价值往往没有价格，因此很难对这些效益加以约束。要理解气候变化对自然资本存量的影响如何影响人类福祉，进而影响碳的社会成本（SCC），不仅需要理解气候变化的生物物理效应，还需要理解这些效应在支撑人类福利方面所起的特定作用。本文综述了从自然资本核算到气候变化经济学的一系列议题，这些议题对于量化气候变化的生态成本并将其纳入SCC计算具有重要意义。

title: Comprehensive New Evidence Implies a Higher Social Cost of CO2
abstract:
The social cost of carbon dioxide (SC-CO
2
) measures the monetized value of the damages to society caused by an incremental metric tonne of CO
2
emissions and is a key metric informing climate policy. Used by governments and other decision-makers in benefit–cost analysis for over a decade, SC-CO
2
estimates draw on climate science, economics, demography and other disciplines. However, a 2017 report by the US National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
1
(NASEM) highlighted that current SC-CO
2
estimates no longer reflect the latest research. The report provided a series of recommendations for improving the scientific basis, transparency and uncertainty characterization of SC-CO
2
estimates. Here we show that improved probabilistic socioeconomic projections, climate models, damage functions, and discounting methods that collectively reflect theoretically consistent valuation of risk, substantially increase estimates of the SC-CO
2
. Our preferred mean SC-CO
2
estimate is $185 per tonne of CO
2
($44–$413 per tCO
2
: 5%–95% range, 2020 US dollars) at a near-term risk-free discount rate of 2%, a value 3.6 times higher than the US government’s current value of $51 per tCO
2
. Our estimates incorporate updated scientific understanding throughout all components of SC-CO
2
estimation in the new open-source Greenhouse Gas Impact Value Estimator (GIVE) model, in a manner fully responsive to the near-term NASEM recommendations. Our higher SC-CO
2
values, compared with estimates currently used in policy evaluation, substantially increase the estimated benefits of greenhouse gas mitigation and thereby increase the expected net benefits of more stringent climate policies.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳的社会成本（SC-CO2）衡量的是每排放一公吨二氧化碳对社会造成的损害的货币价值，是指导气候政策的关键指标。该指标已被政府和其他决策者用于效益成本分析达十余年之久，而SC-CO2估算依赖于气候科学、经济学、人口学等多个学科。然而，美国国家科学、工程和医学院（NASEM）于2017年发布的一份报告[1]指出，现有的SC-CO2估算已不再反映最新研究成果。该报告提出了一系列建议，以改进SC-CO2估算的科学基础、透明度和不确定性刻画。在此，我们表明，改进后的概率性社会经济预测、气候模型、损害函数以及贴现方法（这些方法共同体现了对风险的理论上一致的估值），会大幅提高SC-CO2的估计值。我们偏好的SC-CO2均值估计为每吨二氧化碳185美元（5%至95%分位区间：44美元至413美元，按2020年美元计价），贴现率采用近期无风险贴现率2%，该值是美国政府当前每吨二氧化碳51美元估计值的3.6倍。我们的估算在新的开源温室气体影响价值估算模型（GIVE）中纳入了SC-CO2估算各组成部分的最新科学认识，并完全回应了NASEM关于近期的各项建议。与目前政策评估中使用的估计值相比，我们更高的SC-CO2值大幅提高了温室气体减排的估计效益，从而提高了更严格气候政策的预期净效益。

title: Determinants of Emissions Pathways in the Coupled Climate-Social System
Incorporating Human Behavior into Earth System Modeling
Land-use Emissions Embodied in International Trade
abstract: International trade separates consumption of goods from related environmental impacts, including greenhouse gas emissions from agriculture and land-use change (together referred to as “land-use emissions”). Through use of new emissions estimates and a multiregional input-output model, we evaluated land-use emissions embodied in global trade from 2004 to 2017. Annually, 27% of land-use emissions and 22% of agricultural land are related to agricultural products ultimately consumed in a different region from where they were produced. Roughly three-quarters of embodied emissions are from land-use change, with the largest transfers from lower-income countries such as Brazil, Indonesia, and Argentina to more industrialized regions such as Europe, the United States, and China. Mitigation of global land-use emissions and sustainable development may thus depend on improving the transparency of supply chains.
abstract_zh: 国际贸易将商品消费与相关环境影响割裂开来，这些环境影响包括农业和土地利用变化产生的温室气体排放（统称为“土地利用排放”）。利用新的排放估计和多区域投入产出模型，我们评估了2004年至2017年全球贸易中所隐含的土地利用排放。每年，27%的土地利用排放和22%的农业用地与最终消费地不同于生产地的农产品相关。大约四分之三的隐含排放来自土地利用变化，其中最大的转移方向是从巴西、印度尼西亚和阿根廷等低收入国家流向欧洲、美国和中国等工业化程度更高的地区。因此，减缓全球土地利用排放与实现可持续发展，可能有赖于提高供应链的透明度。

title: Noah's Ark in a Warmer World: Climate Change, Biodiversity Loss and Public Adaptation Costs in the United States
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Climate change poses a growing threat to biodiversity, but the welfare consequences of these changes are not well understood. Here we analyze data on the US Endangered Species Act and project increases in species listing and spending due to climate change. We show that higher endangerment is strongly associated with the probability of listing but also find a large bias toward vertebrate species for both listing and spending. Unmitigated warming would cause the listing of an additional 690 species and committed spending of $21 billion by 2100. Several thousand more species would be critically imperiled by climate change but remain unlisted. Finally, we compare ESA spending with estimates of willingness to pay for conservation of 36 listed species. Aggregate WTP is larger than ESA spending for the vast majority of species even using conservative assumptions and typically one to two orders of magnitude larger than direct ESA spending using less restrictive assumptions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对生物多样性构成日益严重的威胁，但这些变化的福利后果尚未得到充分理解。在此，我们分析了美国《濒危物种法》（ESA）的数据，并预测了气候变化导致的物种列名数量增加及相关支出增长。我们发现，物种的濒危程度与被列名的概率高度相关，但在物种列名和支出方面，也存在对脊椎动物的显著偏向。若不加缓解的变暖将导致到2100年新增690个物种被列名，并产生210亿美元的承诺支出。此外，还有数千个物种将因气候变化而处于极度危急的境地，却仍未被列名。最后，我们将ESA支出与36个已列名物种的支付意愿（WTP）估计值进行了比较。即使采用保守假设，绝大多数物种的总支付意愿仍高于ESA支出；而在较宽松的假设下，其通常比直接的ESA支出高出一到两个数量级。

title: Persistent Effect of Temperature on GDP Identified from Lower Frequency Temperature Variability
abstract: It is well established that temperature variability affects a range of outcomes relevant to human welfare, including health (Gasparrini et al., 2017) emotion and mood (Baylis et al., 2018), and productivity across a number of economic sectors (Carleton & Hsiang, 2016; Dell et al., 2014). However, a critical and still unresolved empirical question is whether temperature variation has a long-lasting effect on economic productivity and, therefore, whether damages compound over time in response to long-lived changes in temperature expected with climate change. Several studies have identified a relationship between temperature and GDP (Burke et al., 2015; Dell et al., 2012; Kalkuhl & Wenz, 2020), but empirical evidence as to the persistence of these effects is still weak. This paper presents a novel approach to isolate the persistent component of temperature effects on output using lower frequency temperature variation. Using three different datasets we find that longer temperature anomalies affect GDP growth as much or more than short-lived anomalies, implying persistent and therefore cumulative effects of climate change on economic output. The population-weighted global effect of -0.8 pp per degree is sufficient to reduce per-capita income in 2100 by 44% under RCP6, approximately an order of magnitude larger than damages currently represented in cost-benefit integrated assessment models (Diaz & Moore, 2017).
abstract_zh: 气温变率影响与人类福利相关的多种结果已是公认事实，包括健康（Gasparrini et al., 2017）、情绪与心境（Baylis et al., 2018），以及多个经济部门的生产率（Carleton & Hsiang, 2016；Dell et al., 2014）。然而，一个关键且仍未解决的实证问题是：气温变化是否对经济生产率具有长期影响，从而使损害随时间累积，以应对气候变化所预期的长期性气温变化。已有若干研究发现了气温与GDP之间的关系（Burke et al., 2015；Dell et al., 2012；Kalkuhl & Wenz, 2020），但关于这些效应持续性的实证证据仍然薄弱。本文提出了一种新方法，利用低频气温变化来分离气温对产出影响中的持续性成分。利用三套不同的数据，我们发现，较长期的气温异常对GDP增长的影响与短暂性异常相当甚至更大，这意味着气候变化对经济产出具有持续性并因此具有累积性的影响。按人口加权的全球效应为每摄氏度−0.8个百分点，足以使RCP6情景下2100年的人均收入降低44%，这一数值比综合评估模型（IAM）目前在成本效益分析中所体现的损害大约高出一个数量级（Diaz & Moore, 2017）。

title: Adaptive Benefits of Agricultural Water Markets in California
abstract: Climate change is expected to increase the scarcity and variability of fresh water supplies in some regions with important implications for irrigated agriculture. By allowing for increased flexibility in response to scarcity and by incentivizing the allocation of water to higher value use, markets can play an important role in limiting the economic losses associated with droughts. Using data on water demand, the seniority of water rights, county agricultural reports, high-resolution data on cropping patterns, and agronomic estimates of crop water requirements, we estimate the benefits of market-based allocations of surface water for California’s Central Valley. Specifically, we estimate the value of irrigation water and compare the agricultural costs of water shortages under the existing legal framework and under an alternate system that allows for trading of water. We find that a more efficient allocation of curtailments could reduce the costs of water shortages by as much as $362 million dollars per year or 4.4% of the net agricultural revenue in California in expectation, implying that institutional and market reform may offer important opportunities for adaptation.
abstract_zh: 预计气候变化将加剧部分地区淡水供应的稀缺性和变异性，对灌溉农业产生重要影响。市场能够在应对稀缺时提供更大的灵活性，并激励水资源向更高价值的用途配置，因而在限制干旱造成的经济损失方面可以发挥重要作用。利用水需求数据、水权优先顺序、县级农业报告、高分辨率的种植格局数据以及作物需水量的农学估计，我们估算了以地表水市场化配置为加州中央谷地带来的效益。具体而言，我们估算了灌溉用水的价值，并比较了在现有法律框架下与允许水权交易的替代制度下，水短缺的农业成本。我们发现，更有效率的供水限制分配，每年可将水短缺成本降低多达3.62亿美元，按期望值计算相当于加州农业净收入的4.4%，这表明制度和市场改革可能为适应气候变化提供重要机会。

title: Environmental Applications of the Coase Theorem
Estimates of Country-Level Temperature-Related Mortality Damage Functions
abstract: Many studies project that climate change is expected to cause a significant number of excess deaths. Yet, in integrated assessment models that determine the social cost of carbon (SCC), human mortality impacts do not reflect the latest scientific understanding. We address this issue by estimating country-level mortality damage functions for temperature-related mortality with global spatial coverage. We rely on projections from the most comprehensive published study in the epidemiology literature of future temperature impacts on mortality (Gasparrini et al. in Lancet Planet Health 1:e360–e367, 2017), which estimated changes in heat- and cold-related mortality for 23 countries over the twenty-first century. We model variation in these mortality projections as a function of baseline climate, future temperature change, and income variables and then project future changes in mortality for every country. We find significant spatial heterogeneity in projected mortality impacts, with hotter and poorer places more adversely affected than colder and richer places. In the absence of income-based adaptation, the global mortality rate in 2080–2099 is expected to increase by 1.8% [95% CI 0.8–2.8%] under a lower-emissions RCP 4.5 scenario and by 6.2% [95% CI 2.5–10.0%] in the very high-emissions RCP 8.5 scenario relative to 2001–2020. When the reduced sensitivity to heat associated with rising incomes, such as greater ability to invest in air conditioning, is accounted for, the expected end-of-century increase in the global mortality rate is 1.1% [95% CI 0.4–1.9%] in RCP 4.5 and 4.2% [95% CI 1.8–6.7%] in RCP 8.5. In addition, we compare recent estimates of climate-change induced excess mortality from diarrheal disease, malaria and dengue fever in 2030 and 2050 with current estimates used in SCC calculations and show these are likely underestimated in current SCC estimates, but are also small compared to more direct temperature effects.
abstract_zh: 许多研究预测，气候变化将导致大量额外死亡。然而，在决定碳的社会成本（SCC）的综合评估模型中，人类死亡率影响并未反映最新的科学认识。为解决这一问题，我们估算了具有全球空间覆盖范围的、按国家划分的温度相关死亡率损害函数。我们依据流行病学文献中最全面的已发表研究对未来气温影响死亡率的预测（Gasparrini et al. 发表于 Lancet Planet Health 1:e360–e367, 2017），该研究估算了21世纪23个国家热相关和冷相关死亡率的变化。我们将这些死亡率预测的变异建模为基准气候、未来气温变化以及收入变量的函数，进而预测每个国家未来死亡率的变化。我们发现，预计的死亡率影响存在显著的空间异质性：气温更高、更贫穷的地方受到的不利影响比更寒冷、更富裕的地方更为严重。在没有基于收入的适应措施的情况下，相对于2001–2020年，2080–2099年全球死亡率预计在较低排放的RCP 4.5情景下将上升1.8%［95%置信区间 0.8–2.8%］，在极高排放的RCP 8.5情景下将上升6.2%［95%置信区间 2.5–10.0%］。若考虑到收入提高带来的对热的敏感性降低（例如更有能力投资空调），本世纪末全球死亡率预计上升幅度在RCP 4.5情景下为1.1%［95%置信区间 0.4–1.9%］，在RCP 8.5情景下为4.2%［95%置信区间 1.8–6.7%］。此外，我们将2030年和2050年气候变化引起的腹泻病、疟疾和登革热额外死亡的近期估计值与SCC计算中目前所用的估计值进行了比较，结果表明，SCC估算中这些损害很可能被低估，但与气温的直接影响相比，这些损害仍然较小。

title: Heat Stress on Agricultural Workers Exacerbates Crop Impacts of Climate Change
abstract:
The direct impacts of climate change on crop yields and human health are individually well-studied, but the interaction between the two have received little attention. Here we analyze the consequences of global warming for agricultural workers and the crops they cultivate using a global economic model (GTAP) with explicit treatment of the physiological impacts of heat stress on humans’ ability to work. Based on two metrics of heat stress and two labor functions, combined with a meta-analysis of crop yields, we provide an analysis of climate, impacts both on agricultural labor force, as well as on staple crop yields, thereby accounting for the interacting effect of climate change on both land and labor. Here we analyze the two sets of impacts on staple crops, while also expanding the labor impacts to highlight the potential importance on non-staple crops. We find, worldwide, labor and yield impacts within staple grains are equally important at +3
∘
C warming, relative to the 1986–2005 baseline. Furthermore, the widely overlooked labor impacts are dominant in two of the most vulnerable regions: sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia. In those regions, heat stress with 3
∘
C global warming could reduce labor capacity in agriculture by 30%–50%, increasing food prices and requiring much higher levels of employment in the farm sector. The global welfare loss at this level of warming could reach $136 billion, with crop prices rising by 5%, relative to baseline.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对作物产量和人类健康的直接影响已分别得到充分研究，但二者之间的相互作用却很少受到关注。在此，我们利用一个全球经济模型（GTAP），分析全球变暖对农业工人及其所种植作物的影响，该模型明确考虑了热应激对人类工作能力的生理影响。基于两种热应激指标和两种劳动函数，并结合作物产量的元分析，我们分析了气候对农业劳动力以及主粮作物产量的影响，从而考虑了气候变化对土地和劳动力的交互效应。在此，我们分析了这两类影响对主粮作物的作用，同时也拓展了劳动力影响的分析，以突出其对非主粮作物的潜在重要性。我们发现，相对于1986–2005年基准，在全球升温+3°C的情况下，全球范围内主要谷物的劳动力影响与产量影响同样重要。此外，在撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚这两个最脆弱的地区，被广泛忽视的劳动力影响占据主导地位。在这些地区，全球升温3°C带来的热应激可能使农业劳动能力降低30%–50%，推高粮食价格，并需要农业部门投入更多就业。在此升温水平下，全球福利损失可能达到1,360亿美元，作物价格相对基准上涨5%。

title: Use and Non-Use Value of Nature and the Social Cost of Carbon
Climate Adaptation by Crop Migration
abstract: Many studies have estimated the adverse effects of climate change on crop yields, however, this literature almost universally assumes a constant geographic distribution of crops in the future. Movement of growing areas to limit exposure to adverse climate conditions has been discussed as a theoretical adaptive response but has not previously been quantified or demonstrated at a global scale. Here, we assess how changes in rainfed crop area have already mediated growing season temperature trends for rainfed maize, wheat, rice, and soybean using spatially-explicit climate and crop area data from 1973 to 2012. Our results suggest that the most damaging impacts of warming on rainfed maize, wheat, and rice have been substantially moderated by the migration of these crops over time and the expansion of irrigation. However, continued migration may incur substantial environmental costs and will depend on socio-economic and political factors in addition to land suitability and climate.
abstract_zh: 许多研究估算了气候变化对作物产量的不利影响，然而，这些文献几乎无一例外地假定未来作物的地理分布保持不变。通过使种植区域迁移以限制作物暴露于不利气候条件，已被作为一种理论上的适应性反应加以讨论，但此前尚未在全球尺度上得到量化或证实。在此，我们利用1973年至2012年的空间明确气候数据和作物种植面积数据，评估了雨养作物种植面积的变化如何已经调节了雨养玉米、小麦、水稻和大豆的生长季气温趋势。我们的结果表明，随着时间推移，这些作物的迁移以及灌溉面积的扩张，已在很大程度上缓解了变暖对雨养玉米、小麦和水稻最具破坏性的影响。然而，持续的迁移可能带来巨大的环境成本，并且除土地适宜性和气候外，还将取决于社会经济和政治因素。

title: Climate and Health Damages of Global Concrete Production
Estimating the Economic Impacts of Climate Change Using Weather Observations
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This article reviews methods that use historical data on weather, climate, economic activity, and other variables to statistically measure the effect of climate on economic outcomes. This has been an active area of research for several decades, with many recent developments and discussions in the literature concerning the best way to estimate climate damages. The article first presents a conceptual framework for estimating the costs of climate change impacts. It then examines several approaches proposed in the literature that use historical weather data to econometrically estimate climate change impacts. These include cross section, linear and nonlinear panel methods, long differences, and partitioning variation. For each approach we describe the type of impacts (short-run versus long-run) estimated, the type of weather or climate variation used (e.g., cross-sectional, time-series, or a combination of the two using panel data), and the advantages and disadvantages of the approach. We conclude with a summary of our findings and priorities for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了利用天气、气候、经济活动及其他变量的历史数据，从统计上衡量气候对经济结果影响的方法。这一领域已有数十年的积极研究，近期文献在如何最好地估算气候损害方面也有许多新进展和讨论。本文首先提出了估算气候变化影响成本的概念框架，然后考察了文献中利用历史天气数据进行计量经济估计气候变化影响的若干方法。这些方法包括横截面方法、线性和非线性面板方法、长差分法以及变异分解法。对于每种方法，我们描述了其所估计的影响类型（短期与长期）、所利用的天气或气候变异类型（例如横截面变异、时间序列变异，或利用面板数据结合二者的变异），以及该方法的优缺点。最后，我们总结了研究发现，并提出了未来研究的重点方向。

title: Impacts of Ozone and Climate Change on California Perennial Crops
Intertemporal Arbitrage of Water and Long-Term Agricultural Investments: Drought, Groundwater Banking, and Perennial Cropping Decisions in California
The COVID-19 Lockdowns: A Window into the Earth System
Using Remarkability to Define Coastal Flooding Thresholds
abstract: Coastal flooding is increasingly common in many areas. However, the degree of inundation and associated disruption depend on local topography as well as the distribution of people, infrastructure and economic activity along the coast. Local measures of flooding that are comparable over large areas are difficult to obtain. Here we use the remarkability of flood events, measured by flood-related posts on social media, to estimate county-specific flood thresholds for shoreline counties along the east coast of the United States. While thresholds in most counties are statistically-indistinguishable from minor flood thresholds of nearby tide gauges, we find evidence that several areas experience noticeable flooding at tide heights lower than existing flood thresholds. These 22 counties include several major cities such as Miami, New York, and Boston, with a total population over 13 million. Our analysis implies that large populations might currently be exposed to nuisance flooding not identified via standard measures.
abstract_zh: 沿海洪涝在许多地区日益普遍。然而，淹没程度及由此造成的干扰，既取决于当地地形，也取决于沿海人口、基础设施和经济活动的分布。难以获得可在大范围内进行比较的地方性洪涝测度。在此，我们利用洪涝事件的显著性（以社交媒体上与洪涝相关的帖子来衡量），估算了美国东海岸沿岸县的县级洪涝阈值。虽然大多数县的阈值与附近验潮站的轻度洪涝阈值在统计上无显著差异，但我们发现，有若干地区在低于现有洪涝阈值的潮位下即出现明显的淹没。这22个县包括迈阿密、纽约和波士顿等主要城市，总人口超过1,300万。我们的分析表明，大量人口目前可能正暴露于标准测度无法识别的扰民性洪涝之中。

title: Rapidly Declining Remarkability of Temperature Anomalies May Obscure Public Perception of Climate Change
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Climate change exposes people to conditions that are historically unusual but that will become increasingly common over time. What kind of weather do people think of as normal or unusual under these changing conditions? We use the volume of social media posts about weather to measure the remarkability of different temperatures and show that remarkability changes rapidly with repeated exposure to unusual temperatures. The reference point for normal conditions appears to be based on weather experienced between 2 and 8 y ago. This rapidly shifting normal baseline means warming noticed by the general public may not be clearly distinguishable from zero over the 21st century, with potential implications for both the acceptance of global warming and public pressure for mitigation policies.
abstract_zh: 气候变化使人们面临历史上罕见、但将随时间日益常见的气象条件。在这些不断变化的条件下，人们认为什么样的天气是正常的，什么样的天气是异常的？我们利用社交媒体上关于天气的帖子数量来衡量不同气温的显著性，并表明，显著性会随着对异常气温的反复暴露而迅速变化。正常条件的参照点似乎基于2至8年前所经历的天气。这种快速移动的正常基准意味着，在21世纪内，公众所察觉到的变暖可能与零之间没有明显区别，这对全球变暖的接受程度以及公众对减排政策的压力都可能产生影响。

title: Understanding the Spatial Distribution of Welfare Impacts of Global Warming on Agriculture and Its Drivers
abstract: This paper explores the interplay between the biophysical and economic geographies of climate change impacts on agriculture. It does so by bridging the extensive literature on climate impacts on yields and physical productivity in global crop production, with the literature on the role of adaptation through international trade in determining the consequences of climate change impacts. Unlike previous work in this area, instead of using a specific crop model or a set of models, we employ a statistical meta‐analysis that encompasses all studies available to the IPCC‐AR5 report. This permits us to isolate specific elements of the spatially heterogeneous biophysical geography of climate impacts, including the role of initial temperature, differential patterns of warming, and varying crop responses to warming across the globe. We combine these climate impact estimates with the Global Trade Analysis Project model of global trade in order to estimate the national welfare changes that are decomposed into three components: the direct (biophysical impact) contribution to welfare, the terms of trade effect, and the allocative efficiency effect. We find that when we remove the spatial variation in climate impacts, the terms of trade impacts are cut in half. Given the inherent heterogeneity of climate impacts in agriculture, this points to the important role of trade in distributing the associated welfare impacts. When we allow the biophysical impacts to vary across the empirically estimated uncertainty range taken from the meta‐analysis, we find that the welfare consequences are highly asymmetric, with much larger losses at the low end of the yield distribution. This interaction between the magnitude and heterogeneity of biophysical climate shocks and their welfare effects highlight the need for detailed representation of both in projecting climate change impacts.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了农业领域气候变化影响的生物物理地理与经济地理之间的相互作用。为此，我们将关于气候变化对产量和物理生产率影响的大量文献（这些文献关注全球作物生产），与关于通过国际贸易进行适应在决定气候变化后果中作用的文献联系起来。与以往研究不同，我们并未使用某一特定作物模型或一组模型，而是采用一项统计元分析，涵盖了IPCC第五次评估报告所能获得的全部研究。这使我们能够分离出气候影响在空间上异质的生物物理地理的特定要素，包括初始气温、差异化的变暖模式，以及作物对全球变暖在不同地区的不同反应。我们将这些气候影响估计与全球贸易分析项目（GTAP）的全球贸易模型相结合，以估算各国的福利变化，并将其分解为三个组成部分：直接（生物物理影响）的福利贡献、贸易条件效应以及配置效率效应。我们发现，若消除气候影响的空间差异，贸易条件影响将减半。鉴于农业气候影响固有的异质性，这表明贸易在分配相关福利影响方面发挥着重要作用。当我们允许生物物理影响在元分析所得的经验不确定性区间内变化时，我们发现福利后果高度不对称，产量分布低端的损失要大得多。生物物理气候冲击的规模与异质性及其福利效应之间的这种相互作用，突出表明在预测气候变化影响时，需要对二者进行详细刻画。

title: Mimi-PAGE: An Open-Source Implementation of the PAGE09 Integrated Assessment Model
Economic Impacts of Climate Change on Agriculture: A Comparison of Process-Based and Statistical Yield Models
abstract: A large number of studies have been published examining the implications of climate change for agricultural productivity that, broadly speaking, can be divided into process-based modeling and statistical approaches. Despite a general perception that results from these methods differ substantially, there have been few direct comparisons. Here we use a data-base of yield impact studies compiled for the IPCC Fifth Assessment Report (Porter et al 2014 ) to systematically compare results from process-based and empirical studies. Controlling for differences in representation of CO 2 fertilization between the two methods, we find little evidence for differences in the yield response to warming. The magnitude of CO 2 fertilization is instead a much larger source of uncertainty. Based on this set of impact results, we find a very limited potential for on-farm adaptation to reduce yield impacts. We use the Global Trade Analysis Project (GTAP) global economic model to estimate welfare consequences of yield changes and find negligible welfare changes for warming of 1 °C–2 °C if CO 2 fertilization is included and large negative effects on welfare without CO 2 . Uncertainty bounds on welfare changes are highly asymmetric, showing substantial probability of large declines in welfare for warming of 2 °C–3 °C even including the CO 2 fertilization effect.
abstract_zh: 大量研究探讨了气候变化对农业生产率的影响，这些研究大体上可分为基于过程的模型方法和统计方法。尽管普遍认为这两类方法的结果存在较大差异，但很少有直接比较。在此，我们利用为IPCC第五次评估报告汇编的产量影响研究数据库（Porter et al. 2014），系统地比较了基于过程研究与实证研究的结果。在控制两种方法对CO2施肥效应处理差异的前提下，我们发现，二者在作物产量对变暖的反应上几乎没有差异。CO2施肥的规模反而是更大的不确定性来源。基于这组影响结果，我们发现农场层面的适应措施减轻产量影响的潜力非常有限。我们利用全球贸易分析项目（GTAP）全球经济模型估算产量变化的福利后果，结果显示，若计入CO2施肥效应，1°C–2°C升温下的福利变化可忽略不计；若不计入CO2效应，则会产生较大的负面福利影响。福利变化的不确定性区间高度不对称；即使计入CO2施肥效应，在2°C–3°C升温下，福利出现大幅下降的概率依然相当可观。

title: Learning, Adaptation, and Weather in a Changing Climate
abstract: Climate change will push the weather experienced by people affected outside the bounds of historic norms, resulting in unprecedented weather events. But people and firms should be able to learn from their experience of unusual weather and adjust their expectations about the climate distribution accordingly. The efficiency of this learning process gives an upper bound on the rate at which adaptation can occur and is therefore important in determining the adjustment costs associated with climate change. Learning about climate change requires people to infer the state of a changing probability distribution (climate) given annual draws from that distribution (weather). If the climate is stationary, it can be inferred from the distribution of historic weather observations, but if it is changing, the inference problem is more challenging. This paper first develops different learning models, including an efficient hierarchical Bayesian model in which the observer learns whether the climate is changing and, if it is, the functional form that describes that change. I contrast this with a less efficient but simpler learning model in which observers react to past changes but are unable to anticipate future changes. I propose a general metric of learning costs based on the average, discounted squared difference between beliefs and the true climate state and use climate model output to calculate this metric for two emissions scenarios, finding substantial relative differences between learning models and scenarios but small absolute values. Geographic differences arise from spatial patterns of warming rates and natural weather variability (noise). Finally, I present results from an experimental game simulating the adaptation decision, which suggests that people are able to learn about a trending climate and respond proactively.
abstract_zh: 气候变化将使人们所经历的天气超出历史常态的范围，从而产生前所未有的天气事件。但人们和企业应当能够从对异常天气的经历中学习，并相应地调整其对气候分布的预期。这一学习过程的效率决定了适应发生速度的上限，因而对于确定气候变化相关的调整成本至关重要。认识气候变化要求人们根据从该分布中逐年抽取的样本（天气），推断一个不断变化的概率分布（气候）的状态。如果气候是平稳的，则可以从历史天气观测的分布中推断出来；但如果气候在变化，推断问题就更具挑战性。本文首先构建了不同的学习模型，包括一个高效的分层贝叶斯模型，在该模型中，观察者既能学习气候是否在变化，也能学习描述这种变化的函数形式。我将其与一个效率较低但更简单的学习模型进行对比，后者中的观察者只对过去的变化作出反应，而无法预见未来的变化。我提出了一个基于信念与真实气候状态之间平均贴现平方差的学习成本一般度量，并利用气候模式输出，针对两种排放情景计算了该指标。结果发现，学习模型和情景之间存在显著的相对差异，但绝对值较小。地理差异源于变暖速率的空间格局以及自然天气变率（噪声）。最后，我展示了一项模拟适应决策的实验博弈结果，表明人们能够学习一个呈趋势变化的气候，并能够主动作出反应。

title: New Science of Climate Change Impacts on Agriculture Implies Higher Social Cost of Carbon
abstract: Despite substantial advances in climate change impact research in recent years, the scientific basis for damage functions in economic models used to calculate the social cost of carbon (SCC) is either undocumented, difficult to trace, or based on a small number of dated studies. Here we present new damage functions based on the current scientific literature and introduce these into an integrated assessment model (IAM) in order to estimate a new SCC. We focus on the agricultural sector, use two methods for determining the yield impacts of warming, and the GTAP CGE model to calculate the economic consequences of yield shocks. These new damage functions reveal far more adverse agricultural impacts than currently represented in IAMs. Impacts in the agriculture increase from net benefits of $2.7 ton−1CO2to net costs of $8.5 ton−1, leading the total SCC to more than double.
abstract_zh: 尽管近年来气候变化影响研究取得了显著进展，但经济模型中用于计算碳的社会成本（SCC）的损害函数，其科学依据要么没有记录、难以追溯，要么仅基于少数过时的研究。在此，我们基于当前的科学文献提出了新的损害函数，并将其引入综合评估模型（IAM），以估算新的SCC。我们聚焦于农业部门，采用两种方法确定变暖对产量的影响，并使用GTAP可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型计算产量冲击的经济后果。这些新的损害函数揭示了远比目前综合评估模型所体现的更为严重的农业不利影响。农业方面的影响从每吨二氧化碳净收益2.7美元转变为每吨8.5美元的净成本，从而使总SCC增长一倍以上。

title: Quantifying the Economic Risks of Climate Change
Temperature Impacts on Economic Growth Warrant Stringent Mitigation Policy
The Fingerprint of Climate Trends on European Crop Yields
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Agriculture is one of the economic sectors most exposed to climate change impacts, but few studies have statistically connected long-term changes in temperature and rainfall with yields. Doing so in Europe is particularly important because yields of wheat and barley have plateaued since the early 1990s and climate change has been suggested as a cause of this stagnation. Here, we show that the impact of climate trends can be detected in the pattern of long-term yield trends in Europe. Although impacts have been large in some areas, the aggregate effect across the continent has been modest. Climate trends can explain 10% of the slowdown in wheat and barley yields, with changes in agriculture and environmental policies possibly responsible for the remainder.
abstract_zh: 农业是受气候变化影响最大的经济部门之一，但很少有研究在统计上将气温和降水的长期变化与产量联系起来。这在欧洲尤为重要，因为自20世纪90年代初以来，小麦和大麦的产量已趋于停滞，而气候变化被认为是导致这一停滞的原因之一。在此，我们表明，气候趋势的影响可以在欧洲作物产量的长期趋势格局中被探测到。尽管在部分地区影响较大，但在整个大陆范围内的总体影响较为有限。气候趋势可以解释小麦和大麦产量放缓的10%，其余部分可能源于农业和环境政策的变化。

title: The Adaptation Potential of European Agriculture in Response to Climate Change
Costing Adaptation: Revealing Tensions in the Normative Basis of Adaptation Policy in Adaptation Cost Estimates
Negotiating Adaptation: Norm Selection and Hybridization in International Climate Negotiations
abstract: Adaptation to the adverse impacts of climate change is a rapidly developing area of policy and the subject of active negotiation at the international level under the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). This article applies theories of norm evolution to the adaptation negotiations. It proposes that the history of these negotiations can best be understood as a contest between two proposed framings that can be roughly characterized as “adaptation as development” and “adaptation as restitution.” These two framings have some similar and some contradictory implications for policy. The article shows that the major areas of consensus and controversy around adaptation in the UNFCCC negotiations map closely to these areas of similarity and contradiction, respectively. Though the “adaptation as restitution” norm is relatively disadvantaged on many measures of norm-fitness suggested by previous authors, it nevertheless appears to help explain the development of adaptation institutions both within and outside the UNFCCC. A hybridized norm that can be described roughly as “like development but different” is coming to characterize international adaptation institutions.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化的不利影响，是一个快速发展的政策领域，也是联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）框架下国际层面积极谈判的议题。本文将规范演化理论应用于适应问题的谈判。我们提出，这些谈判的历史最好被理解为两种提议框架之间的竞争，它们可以大致概括为“作为发展的适应”与“作为补偿的适应”。这两种框架在政策上既有相似之处，也有相互矛盾之处。本文表明，在UNFCCC谈判中，关于适应的主要共识领域与争议领域，分别与这些相似之处和矛盾之处高度对应。尽管“作为补偿的适应”规范在以往作者提出的许多规范适用性指标上处于相对劣势，但它似乎仍有助于解释UNFCCC内外适应机构的发展。一种混合规范正在成为国际适应机构的特征，可以大致描述为“类似发展但又有所不同”。

title: Toppling the Tripod: Sustainable Development, Constructive Ambiguity and the Environmental Challenge
venue: Consilience: The Journal of Sustainable Development

title: Doing Adaptation: The Construction of Adaptive Capacity and its Function in the International Climate Negotiations
Climate Change and Air Pollution: Exploring the Synergies and Potential for Mitigation in Developing Countries
abstract: Air pollutants such as tropospheric ozone and black carbon (soot) also contribute to the greenhouse effect. Black carbon is thought to be the second or third most important anthropogenic contributor to global warming, while troposheric ozone is the fourth most important. Both are also major components of indoor and outdoor air pollution. This paper reviews the existing literature of the health, economic, and climatic impacts of tropospheric ozone and black carbon emissions, together with mitigation options. The local nature of many of the impacts, combined with their short atmospheric lifetime and the existence of cost-effective abatement technologies that are already widely deployed in developed countries means reducing these emissions provides a highly climatically-effective mitigation option that is also appropriate to the development strategy of industrializing countries.
abstract_zh: 对流层臭氧和黑碳（烟尘）等空气污染物同样会加剧温室效应。黑碳被认为是仅次于第一或第三的人为全球变暖贡献因素，而对流层臭氧则是第四大贡献因素。二者也都是室内外空气污染的主要成分。本文回顾了关于对流层臭氧和黑碳排放的健康、经济和气候影响的现有文献，并探讨了缓解选择。这些影响大多具有局地性，加之其大气寿命较短，而且发达国家已广泛部署了具有成本效益的减排技术，因此，减少这些排放是一种对气候极为有效的缓解选择，同时也契合工业化国家的发展战略。
